### Time commitment confirmation

The nominated candidate confirms they can commit to:

- [ ] Engaging with RFCs during the standard 30-day comment window
- [ ] Attending committee discussions (async-first; expect ~2 hours/month)
- [ ] A two-year initial term, renewable indefinitely subject to re-confirmation by the rest of the committee
- [ ] Acting in the interest of the OJCP ecosystem, not solely the interests of their employer
- [ ] Disclosing material conflicts of interest and recusing from votes where required (see [GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md#conflict-of-interest))

### Disclosures

<!--
Required disclosures:
- Any direct commercial relationship between the candidate's employer and Recruitics
- Any pending or in-progress OJCP-adjacent products or specs
- Any prior involvement with competing standards (this is fine — note it for context)
-->

### Public comment period

This nomination will be open for public comment for **30 days** from the date this issue is filed. Members of the OJCP community are encouraged to:

- Endorse the nomination (thumbs-up reaction or comment)
- Raise concerns (comment with specifics)
- Propose alternative candidates (open a separate nomination issue and link here)

After the comment period closes, the bootstrap-period selection process or steady-state vote applies as documented in [GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md#how-seats-are-filled).
